tagline: Bags and totes, cut and stitched in-house.
heroIntro: From weekend duffels to structured totes, our bag lines run on the same in-house leather we tan ourselves. Pattern cutting, dyeing and stitching all happen under one roof, giving us tight control over fit, hardware and finish across a full production run.
characteristics: Cut and stitched from in-house finished leather

title: Hand Bags
blurb: Duffels, totes and travel bags, cut, dyed and stitched from our own finished leather.
